_README: Hand-edited exclusion overrides. Applied by `pnpm ingest` after the
automatic phantom flag, so an entry here always wins.
Key is the shot's timestamp exactly as it appears in data/shots.json
(`shotTimestamp`, naive local wall time). Value is {excluded, reason}.
Exclusions are reversible and reasoned, never deletions — set excluded
to false to bring a shot back. Un-excluding a phantom returns the row to
the ledger but leaves its nulled metrics null: the swing happened, the
ball flight the monitor never saw is not invented to fill the gap.
An override matching no shot is reported as orphaned on every run, so a
typo surfaces immediately instead of silently doing nothing.
